about: 2026-11-18, romrender: the user removed Bret Hart's and Jim Neidhart's Titantron (their Revenge-recorded frames): like any wrestler without one they have none unless the player's folder gives one. Their entrances, one after the other: no video on the screen, the arena's own picture (as tron_novideo_a for Rey Mysterio), never another man's, no crash, the match starts. state.csv's bs_step: tron_qa (tron.c)

expect.name: his music on with no video: nothing picked, the screen's own picture
expect.check: screen == 42 and entrance_step >= 1 and entrance_step <= 29 and (rr_kept_out & 0x10) != 0 and rr_put_out == 0 and (rr_kept_out & 0xF) == 0

expect.name: never another man's video while his music plays with none picked
expect.check: not (screen == 42 and entrance_step >= 1 and entrance_step <= 29 and (rr_kept_out & 0xF) == 2 and rr_put_out == 0)

expect.name: no video on the screen once nobody is entering (the game's own pick after the last man)
expect.check: not (screen == 42 and entrance_step >= 1 and entrance_step <= 29 and ((rr_kept_out >> 8) & 0xF) >= 4 and (rr_kept_out & 0xF) == 2)

expect.name: the match between them started and ran (no crash after their entrances)
expect.check: mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 300 and s0_id == 0x060D and s1_id == 0x060E and bad_mtx == 0
